assumptions.statement_zh: 组织方尚未发布官方总体边界与重点区域 polygon，本方案全部几何为 provisional 临时粗略约束，仅用于内容设计与机器校验；官方图形发布后必须整体复算。
assumptions.statement_en: No official boundary or key-area polygons are published yet; all geometry here is provisional and must be recomputed when official data arrives.

assumptions.statement_zh: 新型城市形态涉及的绿地蓝线、文物保护与建设控制条件未知，本方案不给出任何具体数值结论，仅保留概念口径的示意。
assumptions.statement_en: Statutory protection and control conditions are unknown; this proposal keeps concept-level indications only.

assumptions.statement_zh: 形态研究仅作方向性预判与公开资料口径整理，不替代官方规划，不涉及任何真实个体信息。
assumptions.statement_en: Urban-form research is a direction-level judgement on public information only, not official planning.

assumptions.statement_zh: 元胞坊、智纹台与生长庭是三个原创概念节点，分别服务任务书三区及两翼接口；其形态、运营主体和落位均为概念建议，不构成建设承诺。
assumptions.statement_en: Cellular Block, Smart-Pattern Terrace and Growing Court are three original concept nodes mapped to the taskbook areas and wing interfaces; form, operators and locations are not construction commitments.

assumptions.statement_zh: 空间感知与公众参与仅提供匿名聚合与人工复核兜底，不设个体识别采集，不设无法人工终止的自动决定。
assumptions.statement_en: Space sensing and public participation process anonymized aggregates only, with human review as backstop.

assumptions.statement_zh: 新型城市形态开放日、智纹装置艺术周与元胞市集等均为建议性设计，不代表已确定的政府安排或投资承诺。
assumptions.statement_en: The event system and phasing are design suggestions, not confirmed government or investment commitments.

assumptions.statement_zh: 任务书三区两翼的正式名称、节点映射和 agent.1-agent.6 对照以任务书文本为准；原创节点名不得替代地理框架。
assumptions.statement_en: The taskbook Three Areas, Two Wings and agent.1-agent.6 crosswalk is authoritative for naming; original node names do not replace the geography.

assumptions.statement_zh: T0 样本、窗口、责任人与现场许可尚未具备；TP-01 至 TP-03 和 P1/P2 的数值是 participant-proposed、provisional、待专业论证阈值，不是已测结果。
assumptions.statement_en: T0 samples, windows, owners and field permissions are not yet available; TP-01 to TP-03 and P1/P2 numbers are participant-proposed, provisional thresholds pending professional argument, not measured results.

assumptions.statement_zh: 工业遗存、社区割裂、设施老化、仓储闲置等未有逐项现场证据，统一降级为待验证设计假设/概念情景；升级前需 source_id、日期、空间范围和许可记录。
assumptions.statement_en: Industrial heritage, community severance, aging facilities and vacant warehouses lack itemized field evidence and remain verification-pending design assumptions/concept scenarios until a source, date, spatial scope and permission record are added.

assumptions.statement_zh: 八个案例为文字机制参照，不嵌入第三方图片；案例条目已登记 URL、日期字段与允许/禁止用途，但 review_status 仍需人工核验，usable_for_formal=no。
assumptions.statement_en: The eight cases are text-only mechanism references with no third-party images embedded; URLs, date fields and allowed/prohibited uses are registered, but review_status still requires human verification and usable_for_formal=no.
